adjudication.rationale: In newly added app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, the message handler validates the sender with `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. This is a substring check against the configured forum URL, so an origin that is a prefix of `discourseUrl` (e.g., `http://discourse.example.co` vs `http://discourse.example.com/`) will pass. That allows a non-forum origin to send `discourse-resize` messages and manipulate the embedded iframe height, which is a real security/clickjacking-assist issue in this diff.
